name: Rheine (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of yellow, red and yellow, charged at the centre with the city arms of Rheine (three yellow stars on a red bar on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Rheine; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Rheine arms — three stars on a red bar on yellow
